post.content:
A space hero, a light-powered pilot and a superfan from New Jersey... and every time they use their powers, they swap places. 😅

This is The Marvels, DUMBED DOWN: a funny cartoon recap for Marvel fans of all ages. The magic bangles, the switching problem, the Kree Queen, the singing planet, a cat with a very big mouth, the fight at the sun, and that ending.

⚠️ Spoilers for the whole movie, including the ending.
